title: Federal Ministers and Ministers of State Salaries Allowances And Privileges Amendment Ordinance 1983

sections.shortTitle: Federal Ministers and Ministers of State Salaries Allowances And Privileges Amendment Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE VI OF 1983
FEDERAL MINISTERS AND MINISTERS OF STATE
(SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
ORDINANCE VI OF 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the Federal Ministers
and Ministers of State (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
(Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 21st February, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called the Federal Ministers and
Ministers of State (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Ordinance,
1983.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 3, Act LXII of 1975

ORDINANCE VI OF 1983
FEDERAL MINISTERS AND MINISTERS OF STATE
(SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
ORDINANCE VI OF 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the Federal Ministers
and Ministers of State (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
(Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 21st February, 1983]
No. F. 17 (1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of section 3, Act
LXII of 1975.-In the Federal Ministers and Ministers of State (Salaries and
Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 (LXII of 1975), hereinafter referred to as
the said Act, in section 3, for the words "three thousand" the words
"four thousand" and for the words "two thousand and five
hundred" the words "three thousand" shall be substituted.

3. Amendment of section 4, Act
LXII of 1975.-In the said Act, in section 4, for the words and commas

(a) in
